headline: Revenue growth stays strong, full-year outlook raised
summary_short: Axon reported Q1 FY2026 revenue of $807M, up 33.8% y/y and 1.3% q/q, with diluted EPS of $2.05 and net income of $169M; net income was lifted by a $189M gain on strategic investments alongside GAAP operating income swinging to $29M from an $8.8M year-ago loss.
summary_long: Software & Services revenue rose 35% y/y to $355M (AI products up 700%+); Connected Devices grew 33% to $453M, led by Dedrone (+300%+). Gross margin was 59.1%, down 150bp y/y on tariffs and mix, up 120bp q/q. GAAP operating income swung to $29M from an $8.8M loss y/y; net income of $169M (21% margin) included a $189M gain on strategic investments, versus Adjusted EBITDA of $202M (25.0% margin, management's core metric). Operating cash flow was an outflow of $32M on inventory build and higher interest expense. Cash and short-term investments fell to $731M from $1,719M after $550M of acquisitions. Axon raised FY2026 revenue-growth guidance to 30-32% (from 27-30%) and kept its 25.5% Adjusted EBITDA margin target.
